title: Open Source Python Tool for Linkage Finance Smart Contract Interaction

ms.promise:
For the first milestone, our output will include: 
・the design and architecture of the Python tool

We are defining the exact features needed for the python tool to correctly interact with the linkage platform and how to structure the different functions available within the tool. This technical white paper that includes the design and architecture will then be published on our GitHub.
ms.criteria: Whitepaper outlining the design and architecture of the Python tool to interact with the linkage protocol (including available functions, structure of python program etc. and justification of design choices)
ms.report:
Dear reviewers,
as suggested in the last feedback round we performed a change request with the Catalyst Team (that has been approved). As you can see we adjusted the timeline now accordingly.
For milestone1 you can find our whitepaper as PDF in our GitHub repository: https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/linkage-finance-python-tool/tree/main

ms.promise:
For the second milestone, we aim to deliver the developed Python tool as per the defined architecture, along with comprehensive testing results ensuring its reliability and functionality. Testing results will be in the form of a report.
Outputs (3): 
・delivery of the developed Phython Tool
・comprehensive testing results
・Report about the testing results
ms.criteria:
・python tool interacting with the linkage finance smart contracts
・report showing what tests have been performed to test the python tool and shows that the python tool works correctly for the defined tests (this includes correct transaction building, utxo management, interaction with the protocol)
ms.report:
Dear MRs, 
we have now finished the development of our python tool and released it in our GitHub repository: https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/linkage-finance-python-tool/tree/main
We have added a README file that contains all relevant information for using the tool: https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/linkage-finance-python-tool/tree/main
Moreover, we have written a test suite for our python tool and wrote the results into a test report: https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/linkage-finance-python-tool/blob/main/TEST_REPORT.md
To exemplify the usage of our tools we have created multiple transaction at the compressed version of the linkage finance fund protocol. 
1. Creating the Linkage Fund Factory https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/f9a5a2afb853838de173dbc38639daf67d70323958808e3bbe8d3b96e70a025a
2. Creating a Token Fund https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/d1e26d897b0ab2f50a33a5b697a112528420724184683a68af1ac7d50281b6e7
3. Add tokens to the Token Fund https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/db2603d62c789d7dedce447812d68c37534ed0c0cd353246559f4a41c87376ec
4. Withdraw funds from the created fund https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/473c06757d9b979aaab306f4bffcab7a5a62883d6beadbd8e48dcf6528d173da
5. Collect Fund Token Royalty https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/d99eaa79cb55ad02089af9b7a8c40174ebb4ad503c1da0fcf692071b1a7398d5
